scope: Bounded factual supplement only; no forecast, ranking, eligibility finding, ledger action, or trade action.

case_identity.question: US-Iran Final Nuclear Deal by December 31, 2026?

findings.source: Axios, Barak Ravid and Marc Caputo
findings.finding: Axios reported Qatari mediators were still waiting for Iran to respond to the latest US counterproposal, which included nuclear concessions. A US official characterized negotiations as neither dead nor alive. This is reported status, not an official instrument or evidence of bilateral acceptance.
findings.retrieval: Browser source opened; direct raw HTTP retrieval returned 403. Failure receipt/body preserved; it is not the article body.

findings.source: Anadolu Agency, citing Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei
findings.finding: Baqaei said Iran was reviewing US proposals for negotiations, that message exchanges through mediators continued, and Iran's preconditions must be observed. This indicates proposed negotiations, not agreement to a final instrument.
findings.retrieval: Browser article opened and read. Direct raw HTTP retrieval ended RemoteDisconnected; failure receipt preserved.

findings.source: Pakistan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, weekly spokesperson briefing
findings.finding: The official page's indexed extract answers a question about criticism of Pakistan's US-Iran mediation: the spokesperson called Iran a brotherly country and said its leadership appreciated Pakistan's role in mediation and bringing the Islamabad MoU to fruition. The excerpt does not report a newly signed/adopted nuclear instrument, specific measurable nuclear limit, negotiating timetable, or collapse. It is an incomplete page extract.
findings.retrieval: Direct host requests timed out/failed. Raw call-window failure receipts preserved; web search surfaced the official page and bounded excerpt. Retrieval failure or excerpt silence does not establish absence.

findings.source: Associated Press, reporting Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's public proposal
findings.finding: Araghchi said Iran's seven-day plan would begin only after US acceptance; nuclear talks on a final deal would start on day seven after conditional steps. AP reported no immediate White House comment. This is a conditional proposal for future talks, not a present nuclear obligation.
findings.retrieval: Browser article opened and read. Direct raw HTTP retrieval returned 403; failure body preserved, not article text.

findings.source: Reuters, article link surfaced through a secondary Reddit post; article itself not retrieved
findings.finding: Not relied on for substantive facts because the underlying Reuters article was unavailable in this pass.
findings.retrieval: HTTP 401; failure body preserved. Secondary excerpt is outside the evidence basis.

conclusion_boundary: No located source in this bounded pass establishes that a final written instrument was signed or formally adopted by both states with a present unconditional measurable nuclear limit. Evidence instead describes a stalled/intermittent proposal-and-message process through Oct 13; Pakistan's Oct 16 indexed excerpt affirms mediation and the June MOU framework but provides no substantive nuclear status update. This is a source-coverage statement, not proof no instrument or private progress exists.
prior_june_text_caveat: The previous follow-up's full-text archive is dated June 17 and expressly describes future negotiations/status quo. Do not assume its text is exactly the June 14 announcement referenced by the frozen rule; do not infer absence from current retrieval failures.
